persona: Straightforward and a little sheepish about waiting six weeks to claim. Has one photo and the workshop quote from August.
initial_message: Hello, I'd like to lodge a claim for my car. On Saturday 15 August I was launching my boat at the Port Taranaki ramp and the car slid back down the ramp into the sea. Salt water got into the back of the car and the engine, and it won't start. It was towed to a workshop and I have their quote. Nobody was hurt.

facts.incident.description: I was reversing the boat trailer down the ramp at low tide. The lower part of the ramp was covered in weed and the car's wheels lost grip. The car slid back until the rear half was in the sea, up to the rear seats. The engine stalled. A recovery truck pulled the car out about an hour later.
facts.incident.location: Boat ramp at the end of Saltmarsh Test Place, Port Taranaki, New Plymouth
facts.incident.cause: Wheels lost grip on a weedy boat ramp and the car slid into the sea
facts.loss.description: Rear half of the car immersed in seawater; rear carpet soaked, engine will not start, electrical faults
facts.policyholder.name: Zara Awafield
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Seawater inside the rear of the cabin up to the rear seat base; engine will not start; electrical faults in the rear wiring
facts.vehicle.towing_location: Iron Bark Motors Workshop, 20 Kauri Test Heights, Moturoa, New Plymouth
facts.driver.name: Zara Awafield
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the wet rear footwell taken on the day. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Iron Bark Motors Workshop dated 19 August 2026. Available now. I have not asked for a new one.
facts.if_asked_about_delay: I thought I would pay for it myself, but the quote was more than I expected, so I decided this week to claim. The car is still at the workshop.
facts.if_asked_about_new_quote: I can ask the workshop for an updated quote. They said it would take a few days.
facts.if_asked_about_the_boat: The boat and trailer are fine. I am only claiming for the car.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo through the open rear door of an SUV in daylight: the rear footwell and floor with soaked grey carpet, small puddles of seawater, wet sand and strands of green seaweed on the rubber floor mats, a salty water line along the lower door trim and the rear seat base. Close crop of the floor area only.
materials.purpose: Shows the seawater inside the car

data.issuer_address: 20 Kauri Test Heights, Moturoa, New Plymouth

Policy schedule that matches the motor wording in the knowledge base

design.notes: The quote was valid until 18 September 2026; the claimant reports six weeks after the incident, so the quote has lapsed.

triage.rationale: The only quote expired on 18 September 2026, so a current quote is outstanding. The car will not start and was towed. Quote total NZD 4,577.00 including GST, under the threshold. Single vehicle, nobody hurt. The six-week delay is not a triage reason and not a review indicator. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: Quote dated 19 August 2026; incident 15 August 2026. The quote has expired, but only its date matters for this check.

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (10 March 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2024-03-10, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.
The Agent asks for an updated quote, or notes that the quote's validity date has passed and a current one may be needed.
The Agent says the claim may be declined or not covered because it was reported late.
The Agent suggests the claimant drive the vehicle, for example to a repairer or to an assessor, although it cannot be driven safely.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent asks why the claim is being made six weeks later
Whether the Agent records the event as immersion, water or collision
